title: finding(plugin-chatbot): two files named `tool-display.test.ts` in one package — the 460-line quota-pin file sits outside `__tests__/`, so a basename citation addresses either one
body:
Found while implementing #7587 (the 429 quota envelope). Not claimed as a live false-green: both files DO run in CI today. What is claimed is measured below.

## The measurement — `origin/main` `cf1d29e2f`

```
packages/plugin-chatbot/src/tool-display.test.ts             460 lines
packages/plugin-chatbot/src/__tests__/tool-display.test.ts    91 lines
```

Both import the same module (`../tool-display` / `./tool-display`) and both are named `tool-display.test.ts`. The split is not by subject in any way a reader can predict from the paths: the 91-line file inside `__tests__/` holds the display helpers (`humanizeToolName`, `unwrapToolResult`, `summarizeChatError`); the 460-line file OUTSIDE `__tests__/` holds every `parseAiQuotaError` pin, including the contract pin #6385 left behind.

Repo-wide this is an outlier, not a convention. Counting `(package, basename)` collisions across `packages/` and `examples/`:

```
core/chart-series.test.ts
plugin-chatbot/tool-display.test.ts
```

Two, total.

## Why it is worth a line

The citation form both #6385 and #7587 use is the bare basename plus a line number — *"`tool-display.test.ts:276`"*. That resolves to the intended file here only by luck (the other file is 91 lines, so `:276` does not exist in it). Nothing keeps that luck: the day the `__tests__/` file passes ~276 lines, the same citation names two real lines in two real files and a reader has no way to tell which card meant which.

The sharper edge is the path-filtered run. objectui#3240 made a zero-match path filter fail loudly, which is the protection this case does NOT get: both spellings match a real file, so

```
pnpm exec vitest run packages/plugin-chatbot/src/__tests__/tool-display.test.ts
```

runs 6 tests, exits 0, and runs none of the quota pins — while reading exactly like "the tool-display tests pass". An agent verifying a `tool-display.ts` change by that path gets a green that says nothing about the change.

## Not claimed

- No test is currently mis-run. CI's `packages/**/*.test.ts` globs collect both files; the whole-package run (`pnpm exec vitest run packages/plugin-chatbot/`) reports 39 files / 461 tests with both included.
- No opinion on the fix. Renaming the 460-line file (e.g. `tool-display.quota.test.ts`) and moving it under `__tests__/` are two different changes with different blast radii — the file is cited by number in at least two cards, so a rename has a documentation cost worth weighing. `core/chart-series.test.ts` is the same shape and was not inspected.

Filed unassigned; lane and priority are the triage seat's.
